questions.question: MongoDB là gì và khác SQL databases thế nào?

options.A: MongoDB là SQL database với XML
options.B: MongoDB: document-oriented NoSQL, lưu JSON-like BSON documents, schema-flexible, horizontal scaling tốt, không có JOINs

questions.explanation: MongoDB: document store (không phải table/row). Collection = table, Document = row (BSON). Schema-less: documents trong cùng collection có thể khác structure. Advantages: flexible schema, horizontal scaling (sharding), embedded documents (thay JOIN), good for unstructured/semi-structured data. Disadvantages: no ACID multi-document transactions (trước 4.x), no JOINs (dùng $lookup), eventual consistency. BSON: Binary JSON, hỗ trợ thêm types (Date, ObjectId, Binary).

questions.question: MongoDB CRUD operations cơ bản?
questions.explanation: Insert: db.users.insertOne({name:'Alice', age:25}). Query: db.users.find({age:{$gt:20}}, {name:1, _id:0}). Update: db.users.updateOne({_id:id}, {$set:{age:26}, $push:{tags:'vip'}}). Delete: db.users.deleteMany({active:false}). Operators: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $and, $or, $not. Projection: 1=include, 0=exclude. Cursor: find() trả về cursor, .toArray() hoặc iterate. sort(), limit(), skip() cho pagination.

questions.question: MongoDB Aggregation Pipeline là gì?

options.B: Pipeline: sequence of stages ($match, $group, $sort, $project, $lookup, $unwind) xử lý documents — tương đương SQL GROUP BY + JOIN

questions.explanation: db.orders.aggregate([$match:{status:'completed'}, $group:{_id:'$userId', totalAmount:{$sum:'$amount'}, orderCount:{$sum:1}}, $sort:{totalAmount:-1}, $limit:10]). Stages: $match (filter, dùng index), $group (aggregate), $project (reshape), $sort, $limit, $skip, $lookup (JOIN), $unwind (array → separate docs), $addFields, $count. $lookup: {from:'users', localField:'userId', foreignField:'_id', as:'user'}. Indexes help $match và $sort stages.

questions.question: MongoDB Indexes — types và khi nào cần tạo?

options.A: MongoDB tự index tất cả fields
options.B: Single field, compound, multikey (array), text, geospatial, hashed. Tạo trên fields thường query, sort. EXPLAIN để verify. Index memory và write overhead
options.D: Index không cần thiết với MongoDB

questions.explanation: Single: createIndex({email:1}). Compound: createIndex({status:1, createdAt:-1}) — ESR rule (Equality, Sort, Range). Multikey: tự động khi index array field. Text: $text search. TTL: createIndex({createdAt:1}, {expireAfterSeconds:3600}) — tự xóa expired docs. Partial: createIndex({status:1}, {partialFilterExpression:{status:'active'}}). EXPLAIN: explain('executionStats') — xem IXSCAN vs COLLSCAN. Index limit: 64 per collection. Background indexing: createIndex({...}, {background:true}) (deprecated) → dùng rolling index build cho replica sets.

questions.question: Embedded documents vs Referenced documents — khi nào dùng cái nào?

options.B: Embed khi: data always accessed together, child data nhỏ, 1-few relationship. Reference khi: data lớn, nhiều-nhiều relationship, cần query independently

questions.explanation: Embed (denormalization): {user:{name:'Alice'}, address:{city:'HCM'}} — 1 read. Good for: user profile + address, order + line items, blog post + comments (giới hạn). Bad for: unbounded arrays (vượt 16MB document limit), data cần update many places. Reference (normalization): {userId: ObjectId('...')} + $lookup. Good for: products shared across many orders, users referenced from many collections. Hybrid: embed most-used data, reference less-used. 16MB document size limit.

questions.question: MongoDB memory usage cao — query chậm mặc dù có index. Debug?

options.B: explain('executionStats'), check index usage, Working Set phải fit trong RAM, tối ưu query projection, index intersection

questions.explanation: Debug: (1) explain('executionStats'): docsExamined >> nReturned → index không selective. (2) db.collection.stats(): kiểm tra index sizes. (3) mongoTop: real-time operation stats. (4) mongoStat: server metrics. Working Set: frequently accessed data phải fit trong RAM (wiredTiger cache default 50% RAM). If Working Set > RAM → page faults → slow. Fix: (1) Compound index để cover query. (2) Projection để reduce documents size. (3) Covered query: all fields trong index (no document fetch). (4) Increase RAM hoặc scale out. (5) Archiving old data.

questions.question: MongoDB replica set setup cho high availability?

options.A: Single MongoDB instance là đủ cho production
options.B: Replica set: 1 Primary + 2+ Secondaries. Automatic failover. Read từ secondaries. Write concern và read concern cho consistency

questions.explanation: Replica set: Primary nhận writes, Secondary replicate asynchronously. Automatic failover: nếu Primary down → election → Secondary mới thành Primary (< 12s). Read preferences: primary, primaryPreferred, secondary, secondaryPreferred, nearest. Write concern: {w:'majority'} — confirm write trên majority nodes. Read concern: 'majority' — đọc data confirmed bởi majority. Oplog: capped collection tracking all writes — TTL đủ cho replication lag. Hidden member: không nhận reads, dùng cho reporting. Delayed member: backup với delay. MongoDB Atlas: managed replica set + automatic sharding.
